title: Thanksgiving Festival Chants (Phawar Shad Suk Mynsiem)
cultural_context: The annual thanksgiving spring dance celebration of the Khasi people held at Weiking Grounds in Shillong. Maidens dance gracefully in circles wearing silver crowns (pansngiat) and gold necklaces, while male warriors dance on the outer perimeter waving white whisks (symphiah) and swords (waitlam).
lyrics_khasi:
Teng teng teng, ksing ka la sawa!
Ri lum Ri Khasi ka la kyndit!
Ka sngi ka la kiew ha Weiking,
Ki khun ki kti ki la mih seng!

Ka sngi kaba bhabriew, ka sngi kaba shai,
Ki khun ki kti ki la mih ban shad ha Lympung,
U ksing u sawa, ka tangmuri ka rih,
Ka ksiar bad ka rupa ki phyrnai ha shadem,
Ngin nguh ïa U Blei Nongthaw ha ka shad kmen!

Ryngkat ka pansngiat ba thaba ksiar,
Ka jainsem dhara ba jop pyrthei!
Ki kynthei lui-lui ki shad mian-mian,
Kum ki angel ba hiar na bneng!

Ki samla shlur ba bat waitlam,
Ryngkat ka symphiah ba pynshad kham!
Ki da ia ka burom ka Kur ka Jait,
Ki ieng ha ka Hok ban ym ju lait!

Khublei ko Blei U Nongbuh Nongthaw!
Ba me la ai ia ka suk ka sain!
Ia u kba u khaw ha ki lum ki them,
Ia ka roi ka par ha ka Hima baroh!
lyrics_english:
Boom, boom, resonant booms the great male drum!
The hills of the Khasi homeland awaken to life!
The morning sun has ascended over Weiking arena,
The children and clans assemble in sacred communion!

The glorious day has dawned, bright and pure,
Sons and daughters step forward to dance upon the sacred lympung,
The Ksing drums resound, the Tangmuri sounds its melodious horn,
Gold and silver breastplates shine upon radiant chests,
We bow before God the Creator in our dance of joy!

Crowned with shimmering silver and golden pansngiat,
Draped in prized silk dhara and muga robes!
The gentle maidens glide with downcast eyes in modest steps,
Resembling celestial spirits descending from the heavens!

The brave young men brandish their ancestral swords,
Swinging the white yak whisks in protective arcs!
Shielding the sacred honor of the Clan and Matrilineage,
Standing firm in Righteousness that shall never fail!

Thanksgiving unto Thee, O God, Supreme Creator and Sustainer!
For granting peace, health, and social concord!
For the golden harvest of paddy in hills and valleys,
For prosperity flourishing across every ancestral kingdom!

stanzas.title: Sur Ksing bad Tangmuri (Drum and Pipe Call)
stanzas.khasi:
Teng teng teng, ksing ka la sawa!
Ri lum Ri Khasi ka la kyndit!
Ka sngi ka la kiew ha Weiking,
Ki khun ki kti ki la mih seng!
stanzas.english: Boom, resonant sounds the drum! The Khasi mountains awake! The sun rises over Weiking, the youth assemble in communion!

stanzas.title: Ka Shad Kynthei (The Maiden's Inner Circle)
stanzas.khasi:
Ryngkat ka pansngiat ba thaba ksiar,
Ka jainsem dhara ba jop pyrthei!
Ki kynthei lui-lui ki shad mian-mian,
Kum ki angel ba hiar na bneng!
stanzas.english: Adorned with glowing crowns, clad in golden dhara silk! The gentle maidens dance with delicate, modest footsteps like angels descending from heaven!

stanzas.title: Ka Shad Shynrang (The Warriors' Outer Circle)
stanzas.khasi:
Ki samla shlur ba bat waitlam,
Ryngkat ka symphiah ba pynshad kham!
Ki da ia ka burom ka Kur ka Jait,
Ki ieng ha ka Hok ban ym ju lait!
stanzas.english: The brave youths bearing swords and whisks circle around! Guarding the sacred honor of clan and motherhood, anchored in everlasting righteousness!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingnguh Blei (Prayer of Thanksgiving)
stanzas.khasi:
Khublei ko Blei U Nongbuh Nongthaw!
Ba me la ai ia ka suk ka sain!
Ia u kba u khaw ha ki lum ki them,
Ia ka roi ka par ha ka Hima baroh!
stanzas.english: Thanks be to God the Creator and Sustainer! For bestowing peace and harvest, prosperity and health upon the entire realm!

vocabulary.pansngiat: Sacred crown made of pure silver or gold worn by unmarried maidens
vocabulary.jainsem dhara: Traditional ceremonial two-piece Khasi silk garment woven from mulberry silk
vocabulary.waitlam: Two-handed curved indigenous ceremonial steel sword
vocabulary.symphiah: Sacred white whisk carried by male dancers representing protection of maternal clan
vocabulary.lympung: Open consecrated grassy dance square or ceremonial amphitheater
vocabulary.suk mynsiem: Peace of soul, state of inner tranquility and spiritual contentment
